page: Google Cloud Platform m4n-megamem-28 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the m4n server family. It features 28 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 372.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of approximately 13.29 GB of RAM per core, designed specifically for workloads that require substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPU accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the m4n-megamem-28 offers a specialized hardware profile that minimizes compute overhead while maximizing memory density. This resource balance is suitable for memory-intensive applications such as in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing pipelines that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
